diagnosis: Reconciled pre-2026 losing inventory persisted through sustained observed downtrends because the return forecast also had to become negative before a slow-trend exit was authorized. Fresh vacancies could then be funded on short rebounds without evidence of a rising medium trend. Account discrepancies and nightly weight drift do not explain this loss.
hypothesis: Model forecasts are useful ranking inputs but cannot veto independently observed persistent trend failure. Requiring a rising observable trend for new risk and exiting confirmed negative trends can improve the failed joint risk/return trade-off while retaining funded winning units. This is a new bounded hypothesis, not a claim it will pass.

rules.individual_exit: At a completed close, independently latch full liquidation when close has been below the candidate EMA for two consecutive closes and the 20-session return is negative. Optimistic model forecasts cannot cancel it. Existing tail, stale-quote, daily-loss and replacement exits remain. Pending orders must actually liquidate before readmission can start.
rules.new_risk: Existing nonlinear entry requirements remain. Any increase additionally requires close above the candidate EMA and that EMA above its value five sessions earlier. Denied increases leave existing funded units untouched.
rules.market_admission: Only for require_market_trend=true, new risk also requires the equal-weight compounded fresh-quote return index of exactly the supplied universe above its EMA60 and that EMA above its value five sessions earlier. Missing quotes do not become zero-return observations. This market gate never independently sells intact held units and never requires account NAV to recover to its permanent peak.
rules.execution: Signal-close fixed-unit intents, real cash/inventory, next-session execution, fees, liquidity, limits, board lots and T+1 remain unchanged. No same-close hypothetical sale proceeds fund purchases. No per-stock, per-sector or date branches, no outside-universe information, and no copied trades strategy code.

selection: The existing core incumbent wealth/drawdown/fill nonregression screen, then minimax normalized deficit and its unchanged objective, using only the three existing scopes through 2025-12-31. Preserve all four candidates and all raw results. This iterative design has seen the history and is not an independent holdout; 2026 remains retrospective.
verification: optimistic forecast cannot veto observed exit
new-risk gates do not liquidate intact inventory
original_goals: Unchanged original four-reference return, crash protection and universe/generalization goals. This necessary core test alone is not acceptance or permission to promote.
